purpose.zh: 撑住身体，练双腿收回和伸直的控制
purpose.en: Stay up on your hands and control your legs as they tuck and straighten.

text.zh: 撑住不落地，腿伸直成L撑再收回膝盖
text.en: Stay up on your hands, straighten your legs into an L, then pull your knees back in
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.

text.zh: 收腿时脚跟收到身体下面。
text.en: When you tuck, pull your heels in under you.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back instead of tucking your knees.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时少做一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, do less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 改名：「L 撑↔团身」带箭头念不出 → L撑收腿伸腿
动画从团身开始：伸成L撑 1.0 s / 停 0.5 s / 收回 1.0 s / 团身停 1.5 s；口令顺序改成 伸直腿→停→收膝盖（原 start「收腿」peak「伸直」与动画顺序相反）
purpose 去掉「屈髋」；剂量 5 → 6 次
flags: 改名：L 撑↔团身 → L撑收腿伸腿
动画一次循环里两下之间只停 0.5 s、循环接缝处停 2.5 s，rest 取平均 1.5 s
